description: For every allowance \(k\), the zero program fails in bounded evaluation at input \(k\), although its partial evaluation there is defined with output zero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.no_fixed_allowance (k : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.bounded Nat.Partrec.Code.zero k k = none ∧
    Nat.Partrec.Code.zero.eval k = Part.some 0
